selected_manifest_contract.building_entry: buildings.<short>.points_path, optional points_key(default world_local_xyz), coordinates(gs_local or epsg25832)
selected_manifest_contract.note: Use --selected-points-manifest to replace the 2px cache without changing fitting, fill, or scoring code. Footprint containment is always recomputed.

plane_fit.method: deterministic numpy RANSAC z=ax+by+c for ax/by, then absolute-height recenter c=median(z_all_inside)-median(ax*x_all+by*y_all)

fill.cell_rule: every globally aligned 0.5m cell intersecting the supplied footprint receives one representative interior point on the fitted plane
fill.footprint_role: explicit P0 plane extension and score/coverage spatial mask only

roofer_readout.original_adapter_reason: validated repository adapters pass the supplied external footprint/roofprint directly to Roofer; final Stage-3 forbids that reconstruction input

adapter.name: point_evidence_derived_roofprint
adapter.polygon_rule: union of globally aligned 0.5m occupied cells reconstructed from P0 fill points; no clip/intersection with supplied footprint after point generation
adapter.indirect_dependency: P0 fill points were generated inside the supplied footprint; the supplied footprint itself is never passed to Roofer
adapter.ground_source_rule: building_summary ground_z_local_m from clean exterior SfM+dense-init observations; no LoD2 or ALS elevation

substantive_filter.definition: roofer_status=success AND raw LoD2.2 geometry exists AND val3dity_valid AND rf_extrusion_mode not forbidden AND rf_roof_planes>0 AND citygml_roof_rms_m<=3.0 AND citygml_completeness>=0.5

mvs.no_points_rule: report separately: direct class-6 count==0 and canonical Roofer reason==pointcloud_unusable_no_points
